defects.workstream: Workstream A: Priority 0 Trust Root Establishment & Caller Override Elimination
defects.summary: Operational trust anchor allowed environment/caller overrides; repository key file was not verified against pinned root authority
defects.directiveRequirement: Audit all trust-anchor resolution paths. Require operational trust anchor to match an independently approved, protected fingerprint. Reject caller-supplied keys and fingerprints as ways of changing the operational verifier's trust. Verify repository-file key against pinned trust identity. Fail closed if provenance cannot be established. Separate test-only public keys. Add adversarial tests.
defects.remediationDetails: Pinned APPROVED_OPERATIONAL_TRUST_ANCHOR_FINGERPRINTS in scripts/lib/stagingAuthorization.mjs to canonical CTO root public key fingerprint '2a046c4d9b71f5ce4478aa271b778bc80a7b1d3c6b28c7af0286d9f6df5f4e9a' from governance/authorities/cto_root_public_key.pem. Set DEFAULT_PUBLIC_KEY_PATH to canonical CTO root key. In operational mode (isTestVerification: false), strictly reject caller-supplied approvedFingerprint overrides with CALLER_FINGERPRINT_OVERRIDE_FORBIDDEN and caller-supplied storePath overrides with CALLER_REPLAY_STORE_OVERRIDE_FORBIDDEN. Enforce repository key file verification against pinned fingerprints. Isolated test-only mock verification using explicit isTestVerification parameter. Added adversarial tests (Tests 30-34) in tests/staging-authorization-verifier.test.mjs proving that self-generated keys with matching environment fingerprints cannot bootstrap operational trust.

defects.workstream: Workstream A: Real Administrative Containment Enforcement
defects.summary: Administrative incident containment required proof of administrator credential rotation and access log audit
defects.directiveRequirement: Administrative containment must be real. The responsible project administrator must complete and evidence all applicable actions (credential rotation, confirmation that replacement credentials are active, access log review). Capture only minimum evidence without secrets. The agent must not declare containment resolved from a code change alone. Fail closed if unconfirmed.
defects.remediationDetails: Verified that staging execution remains strictly fail-closed with ADMIN_CONTAINMENT_UNCONFIRMED in scripts/lib/stagingAuthorization.mjs and scripts/execute_staging_directive_139.mjs because no genuine signed administrator closure record exists in the environment or repository. Zero credentials fabricated. Staging execution truthfully held in CONTAINMENT_PENDING_ADMIN_CONFIRMATION / BLOCKED_AUTHORIZATION.

defects.remediationDetails: Authored comprehensive specification reports/w021_5_stage1_idempotency_specification.md detailing: 1) Pre-seeded primary key vs client UUIDv5 divergence; 2) PostgREST 23505 unique constraint violations on uq_org_multi_name, uq_org_symbols_timeline; 3) Temporal advisory lock trigger violations on fn_validate_org_alias_temporal_invariants and fn_validate_org_symbol_temporal_invariants; 4) Three safe repeat-write strategies (natural-key conflict targets, target-state read reconciliation, and canonical migration PL/pgSQL sync procedure); 5) Governance rationale maintaining Stage 1 in BLOCKED_NOT_DEPLOYABLE with 0 outbound rows until staging execution authorization is granted.

defects.directiveRequirement: Resolve the six recorded external blockers EB-01 through EB-06 with genuine evidence and the necessary independent authorizations.
